source_state: Uncommitted authorized v2.4.0 version bump plus report-builder/sharing implementation. No release/deployment/live migration.
method: Actual React components and shared EQM styles; real FastAPI routes and disposable SQLite; headless Edge desktop 1480x1100/mobile 390x844. Rendered component/full-page captures; no repainting.
data: Synthetic Demo systems/pilots/organizations, canonical combat fixtures, internal public/private observations, ESI Last-Modified hour samples and source fixtures. No production users/SSO/ESI/zKill or private gameplay data.

checks: System lookup/run, retained killmails, latest ESI capture, all analytics default-collapsed and five hourly charts plus UTC distribution
Separate visible sighting frequency/hulls exclude another analyst’s private scan; explicit zKill imports then respects shared hourly cache
Private-by-default and anonymous snapshot controls; anonymous public route shows fixed public combat data without observations, notes, refresh controls or live source queries
The real full EQM App entry point opens an Intel snapshot for an anonymous reader without requiring sign-in
Revocation cancel/confirm and server-side anonymous denial remove the stale public report
Character, corporation and alliance lookups use identical report controls with most-active systems, combat hulls, activity hours and recent killmails
Legacy saved-dossier navigation stays available; expanded system charts and tables fit 390px mobile without page overflow

backend_validation.migration: 0109 upgrade/downgrade in disposable SQLite only; no live/PostgreSQL migration/interleaving test

limitations: No live source completeness or real-player traffic claim. Existing screenshot receipts under v2.3.0 are untouched. Historical ESI series is synthetic in captures; real samples accumulate on report/activity requests.
